kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tab.kosong: This disciple's heart is not read yet. Stay near it for a moment.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tab.ingatan: Nothing has left a mark yet.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tab.kesetia: Contentment blended with the master bond. Below 50 restless, below 30 defiant.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tab.keadaan: Its heart is at peace in this sect.
Something weighs on it; it often stares into the distance.
Refuses duties and half the orders.
Quietly preparing to leave the sect.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tab.sisa: Leaves in %s days unless cared for!
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tab.terikat: Bound by the Soul Seal / heir: will never leave.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tab.pend.1: Will challenge you to a duel!
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tab.pend.3: Waiting for nightfall to slip away…
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tab.pend.6: About to defect to another sect!
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tab.kepuasa: Rises when taught, given pills, meditating beside you, praised and talked to. Falls when struck, neglected, overworked or shamed.
The existing bond (teaching +5, a pill +2, shared meditation). A strong bond holds loyalty.
Once a day: hear what is on its heart. Contentment +4 (Humble +6).
Give the item in your hand: a pill, a spirit herb or a spirit stone. +2 to +6 by its worth, three a day.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.btn.maaf.de: Stand with it before the Hall stele and apologise. Contentment +10, once every three days.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.btn.usir.de: Expels the disciple (its record is kept in the list of those who left). Every other disciple is disappointed.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.btn.usir.te: A soul-sealed disciple or the heir cannot be expelled.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.sumber: Source: Han Li (A Record of a Mortal's Journey), Bai Xiaochun (A Will Eternal), Xiao Yan and Yao Lao (Battle Through the Heavens), Wang Lin (Renegade Immortal).
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.efek.malas: Meditation -10% XP, work -20%, half as hurt by neglect.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.efek.sombon: Damage +5% in duels, twice as hurt when shamed.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.efek.setia: Loyalty +15, prepares to leave only below 10.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.efek.licik: May defect to a hostile sect if it ever leaves.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.efek.berani: Half as hurt when sacrificed; rebels openly if it leaves.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.efek.ambisi: Foundation chance +3%, twice as hurt when passed over; may ask leave to wander.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.efek.tenang: Half the daily change of contentment.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.efek.penyay: +1 contentment a day with a friend; grieves more deeply.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.efek.penden: Bad memories cut deeper; may be born of a friend's betrayal.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.bicara.seti: My qi feels clear today, Master. Thank you for guiding me.
If this sect is ever in danger, I will stand at the front.
I dreamt we both watched the sea of clouds from the highest peak.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.bicara.geli: Forgive me, Master… my thoughts wander a lot lately.
Am I still of any use to this sect?
I am… just tired. Perhaps tomorrow will be better.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.bicara.memb: Why is it always me who is ordered about? The others are left alone.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.bicara.akan: The Dao is wide, Master. Perhaps my road is not here.
…I have been thinking about something for a while. Another time.
Out there someone surely values my talent.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.bicara.sifa: I was up before dawn practising the forms. May I show you?
One more cycle… then another. That is how one reaches the peak, isn't it?
Master, isn't meditating lying down still meditation?
Such a fine day. A pity to waste it on work…
Disciples of other sects? They are no match for me.
Soon my name will be on the Strength Ranking.
I still have much to learn from you and my senior brothers and sisters.
If I am wrong, please correct me, Master.
Wherever you go, Master, I follow.
This sect is my home. I have no other.
I heard interesting news in town… free for you, of course, Master.
Sometimes the winding road is quicker than the straight one, no?
Send me to the next front line, Master!
The demonic beast yesterday? I want to fight it again.
Master… is there a raid tonight? I heard strange sounds.
I would rather tend the herb fields than fight…
When may I attempt my next breakthrough?
One day I want to stand level with you, Master.
The wind on the peak is never in a hurry. I learn from it.
Whatever happens, the heart should be like still water.
A junior was hurt yesterday. I brought them some medicine.
Have you eaten, Master? I set aside some spirit porridge for you.
I will not forget who shamed me.
Ten years is not long to repay a grudge.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.bicara.suda: %s has said a lot today. Tomorrow again.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.hadiah.buka: Hold a pill, a spirit herb or a spirit stone to give a gift.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.maaf.tunggu: An apology too often loses its meaning. Try again in %s days.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.maaf.aula: An apology must be made before the Hall stele, with the disciple there (within 12 blocks).
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.maaf.ok: You bow before the ancestral stele. %s answers with a deep bow.
%s turns defiant: it refuses duties and half your orders. Talk to it.
%s is preparing to leave the sect! About %s days unless something changes.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tolak.tugas: %s leaves its duty and sulks with crossed arms.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tolak.perin: %s looks away and will not obey the order "%s".
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tolak.pergi: %s no longer listens to any order.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.ujian_hati: The heart trial on the stair changed %s: %s became %s.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tantang.aja: %s stands tall before you: "Master, today I challenge you!" %s %s
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tantang.mul: The honour duel with %s begins. Defeat it to win back its heart.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tantang.lew: %s waited for your answer, then turned away in anger.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.tantang.tun: %s bows its head: "I lost. I will stay in this sect."
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.pamit.minta: %s bows: "Master, I wish to wander and seek my own Dao. May I?" %s %s
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.pamit.ditol: %s swallows its disappointment and goes back to its place.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.pamit.lewat: %s got no answer and drops the idea for now.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.pergi.mingg: %s slipped out of the sect at night with a small bundle.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.pergi.menge: %s takes its leave with respect and goes wandering. Perhaps one day it returns.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.kembali.ok: %s has come back to the sect!
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.kembali.pen: %s wants to come back, but the sect is full (%s/%s).
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.kembali.gag: %s cannot come back right now (the place is not loaded).
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.blok.boleh: Disciple departures are off in the config (kepribadian.bolehPergi).
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.blok.guru: Its master is not in the world.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.blok.terika: %s is bound by the Soul Seal or is the heir: it will never leave the sect.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.log.tantang: %s challenged the Sect Master to a duel.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.log.maaf: The Sect Master apologised to %s before the stele.
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.ingat.bicar: A warm talk with the Master
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.ingat.maaf: The Master apologised before the stele
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.ingat.tundu: Lost a duel to the Master and submitted
kultivator.sekte.kepribadian.ingat.ujian: Forged its heart on the Thousand Steps
